{% if letter_head and not no_letterhead -%}
{{ letter_head }}
{%- endif %}

REF NO: {{ doc.name or "" }}

SALARY INCREMENT LETTER
{{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.posting_date or frappe.utils.nowdate()) }}

To,
Name: {{ doc.employee_name }}
Designation: {{ doc.designation }}
Employee ID: {{ doc.employee }}
Date of Joining: {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.date_of_joining) }}

Dear {{ doc.employee_name.split(" ")[0] }},

We are pleased to inform you that your salary has been revised w.e.f {{ doc.get_formatted("from_date") or "" }} and the new structure will be as below:

Increment Percentage—{{ doc.increment_percentage or "0.0" }}%+

{% for row in doc.salary_component %} {% endfor %}
Components Current Salary {{ doc.currency or "" }} Revised Salary {{ doc.currency or "" }}
{{ row.component }} {{ row.current_salary }} {{ row.revised_salary }}


The other terms and conditions of your Employment Offer/Contract will remain unchanged. We look forward to your valuable contributions and wish you all the best for a rewarding career with the organization.

Sincerely,

__________________________
Sha Bhaskaran
Managing Director & CEO

Acceptance by the Employee:

I confirm my acceptance to the terms and conditions of the above increment.


Name: ____________________________

Signature: ____________________________

Date: ____________________________

{% if footer and not no_letterhead %}
{{ footer }}
{% endif %}
name: Increment Letter
